name: Rustling Grass
desc: A Pokémon is trapped in the tall grass.
choice3After: You have no time to get involved.

name: Pokémon's Thanks
desc: To thank you, the Pokémon brings you a reward.

name: The Hunter's Revenge
choice2After: You trip while fleeing and scrape your head, but he doesn't catch up.
desc: You stole the hunter's dinner; now he demands a duel.

name: End of the Road
desc: Ready to head to the next region?

name: Masters Division
desc: You've reached the Masters arena entrance. Trainer, are you ready? (Entering the Masters counts as clearing the run and settles related clear achievements.)

name: Ready to Go
desc: What should you bring on the adventure?

name: Pitch-Black Cave
choice1After: You find something useful in the cave.
choiceDesc1: Go inside (requires a Fire-type Pokémon on your team)
desc: Something seems to be in the cave, but it's pitch black inside.

name: Empty Belly
choice2After: Eating it raw, your stomach hurts the whole way.
choiceDesc1: Cook it (requires a Fire-type Pokémon on your team)
desc: Your stomach won't stop growling, so you catch a few fish in the river.

name: Fallen Tree
choice2After: You accidentally start a forest fire and get a harsh fine from the rangers.
choiceDesc2: Burn it (requires a Fire-type Pokémon on your team)
choiceDesc1: Move it (requires a Fighting-type Pokémon on your team)
desc: A huge tree trunk blocks the road.

name: The Cliff
choiceDesc2: Fly to the far side (requires a Flying-type Pokémon on your team)
choice1After: Below the cliff is a narrow path that seems to lead somewhere.
choiceDesc1: Climb down with vines (requires a Grass-type Pokémon on your team)
desc: A steep cliff lies ahead; there's no way forward.

name: Forest Dwellers
choiceDesc2: Looks like a battle can't be avoided
choiceDesc1: Send Pokémon to talk (requires a Grass-type Pokémon on your team)
desc: The forest Pokémon seem hostile to outsiders.
choice3After: The residents thank you, heal you, and give you plenty of gold.

name: Firefly Woods
choiceDesc2: Picnic (requires a Lunch Box in hand)
desc: A quiet, beautiful forest.

name: Rogue Hideout
choice1After: While they sleep, you grab a few things.
choiceDesc1: Blend in (requires a Dark-type Pokémon on your team)
desc: You've wandered into rogue territory…

name: The Arena
choice2After: The brawl is so rough you get caught in the crossfire.
choiceDesc1: Join the challenge (requires a Fighting-type Pokémon on your team)
desc: Shouts echo nearby—a fierce fighting tournament seems to be underway.

name: Ancient Tomb
choiceDesc1: Speak with the spirits (requires a Ghost-type Pokémon on your team)
desc: An old tomb full of drifting spirits—they don't seem to like being disturbed.

name: Rampaging Pokémon
choiceDesc2: Break the mind control (requires a Psychic-type Pokémon on your team)
desc: They look mind-controlled.

name: Potion Seller
desc: I've got some curious potions for sale—try my new brew and I won't charge you.

name: Lost
choiceDesc2: Go where the growth rings are tight
choice1After: You find your way out of the forest.
choiceDesc1: Go where the growth rings are sparse
desc: You're lost in the woods. The map says the exit is south—which way do you go?

name: Theft
choice1After: You trip chasing them, but you recover all your money.
desc: A shadowy figure stole your money.

name: Strange Egg
desc: A strange egg sits in the grass.

name: Professor's Lab
choice1After: The Professor thanks you and funds your journey.
choiceDesc1: Ask the Professor to study it (requires a Strange Egg in hand)
desc: You arrive at the Professor's research lab.

desc: A Pokémon is trapped in the tall grass.

name: Gratitude

choiceDesc2: It gives you a bundle of herbs
choiceDesc1: It gives you a strange item
desc: You meet the Pokémon you rescued before.

choice2After: You hurt yourself scrambling to escape.
desc: You stole the hunter's dinner; now he demands a duel.

choiceDesc2: Open it and see what's inside

desc: A black parcel lies by the road. The label reads: "To Professor Oak."

desc: You arrive at the Professor's research lab.
